lights_fit_from_sphere — DRIVE tacscalib op

• Data kinds: rgb × normalmap × image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.lights_fit_from_sphere(diffs, normals, masks, order: 'int' = 0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import tacscalib; tacscalib.lights_fit_from_sphere(diffs, normals, masks, order: 'int' = 0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("lights_fit_from_sphere"))

Usage

Solves a per-channel linear Lambertian model by least squares from background-subtracted images (1 image or a sequence) and known normals.

order=0: I_c = a_c + l_c · n (3 channels × 4 = 12 parameters). order=2 (for diagnosis): each of the 4 coefficients is a quadratic in position (24 per channel, 72 parameters in total) —— separates whether the residual of the linear model comes from "non-uniform illumination" or "non-linear reflection". diffs (H, W, 3) or a list of them, a list of normals (H, W, 3), a list of masks (H, W) bool.

Returns: order, L (3, 3) (row c = l_c, length = channel intensity; for order 2 the value at the image centre), ambient (3,), rms (3,) (fit residual), n_rows (number of pixels used), cond (condition number of the design matrix), and for order 2 coef (4, 6, 3) and image_shape. Raises ValueError: mismatched list lengths or shapes / order other than 0 or 2 / fewer pixels than unknowns / degenerate normals (on a plane).
